thread.text: Compare how the two lanes handle the same follow-up about delivery windows.

thread.title: Delivery window
thread.text: The bakery offers pickup between one oh three and one thirteen this afternoon, and delivery adds a service fee of two dollars forty. Pickup is cheaper and sooner, so the plan keeps pickup unless the customer asks for delivery, and it records the window in the order so the receipt shows it.

thread.title: Verdict: pickup
thread.text: The order matches the request: one egg sandwich on a milk bun, no meat, with guacamole, for pickup in the stated window, total eleven dollars forty including tip. Nothing in it needs the customer's confirmation, so it can be placed now.
